history.content: Hello Karen! Welcome to Ashcombe & Rowe Estates. Are you looking to buy or sell a home?
Do you have a specific property in mind?
Which property is it? Please share the property name or address.

Great news, Karen, 'Apartment 1, Aldermoor Place' is available! It is a 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment priced at £1,330,000.

Can I get your phone number so our team can arrange a viewing?
Thank you! Can I get your email address?
Someone will get in touch within 24 hours via phone or email. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Thank you for chatting with us. Goodbye.
